response:
What you're describing—being called vulgar names, having everything you do treated as wrong, and this escalating over time—is verbal abuse, regardless of what it's labeled. Calling it "angry verbal bashing" doesn't change the impact it's having on you. You deserve to be treated with respect, especially by someone who's supposed to care about you.

It's not your fault that she gets angry, and no amount of "doing things right" will prevent someone else's choice to lash out. That pattern of escalation is worth taking seriously. You might consider talking with a therapist or contacting a domestic violence support line (in the US, 1-800-799-7233), which also assists with verbal and emotional abuse and can help you think through your situation confidentially.

If things ever feel physically unsafe, please reach out to emergency services or someone you trust right away. You don't have to carry this alone.
